_comment: C0-12 pipedream bodies EN. 无附加小节。正文「相关条目」1 行带 .md 链接（zapier），related 写 1 条。

axes.model_access: Workflow steps can connect to each vendor's LLMs (official AI-integration docs line); the specific list has not been verified item by item. The signature trait is "code-first automation": steps can be written in Node/Python/Bash, while the UI's main axis is still assembling flows.
axes.runtime: Cloud-hosted runtime (officially managed execution); there is also a local CLI/SDK development surface. No official statement of a full self-hosted form.
axes.local_files: Execution happens on Pipedream's cloud; locally you develop and deploy via CLI/SDK.
axes.background: Cloud-hosted residency is the default form: scheduling, webhooks, queues and retries are carried by the platform while your machine only handles development and deployment; "keeps running when your laptop is off" naturally holds in the hosted form.
axes.tools: Official component ecosystem (apps/components) + Connect embedded integration (plugging your app into other people's workflows); MCP support status not verified item by item.
axes.context: Workflow state and store key-values are the official persistence surface; cross-workflow memory not verified item by item.
axes.permissions: OAuth credentials are hosted by the platform (the Connect line is its commercial main axis); enterprise-compliance claims not verified item by item.
axes.fit: Fits: developer-oriented automation (code + UI hybrid); SaaS wanting to be "integrated into" (Connect line). Does not fit: teams that never want to touch code (that's Zapier/Make territory).

runs: This site has not completed measured runs. The closest test protocol is the code-side [protocols/framework/_protocol.md](../../../protocols/framework/_protocol.md) (the tool-calling and credential-boundary sections are reusable; no workflow-platform-specific protocol exists on this site yet).
unknowns:
- The full per-repo open-source license picture (source-available details not verified repo by repo)
- MCP support status (no official documentation found)
- Self-hosted form (no official statement — treated as unknown)
related: Form-style vs code-style contrast: both connector automation — Pipedream treats code as a first-class citizen.
sources: Pipedream · official community (updates and Q&A entry point)
